title: Mziki Owl Cam
description: Verreaux's Eagle Owl breeding will begin between March and September. Currently this camera is down as there is no activity. We'll keep you updated closer to the Verreaux's breeding season!
html:
Last year, EcoSolutions installed a tyre nest in a tree in Mziki Game Reserve ... with amazing success! 1000's of excited viewers were glued to the Owl Cam watching the female Verreaux's Eagle Owl (Bubo lacteus) raise her owlet. We are all keen to watch the beautiful process again!

Please sign up to Disqus below and feel free to share comments, pictures and special moments.
